name: Strapi REST API
description:
OpenAPI description of the Strapi 5 headless CMS REST API, generated from the official documentation (https://docs.strapi.io/cms/api/rest).

Strapi auto-generates REST endpoints for every content type in an instance. Two shapes exist:
- **Collection types** (many entries) are served at `/{pluralApiId}` and `/{pluralApiId}/{documentId}` and support list/create/read-one/update/delete.
- **Single types** (one global entry) are served at `/{singularApiId}` and support read/update/delete.

Because the resource segment is per-instance, the generic paths use a templated `{pluralApiId}` / `{singularApiId}` / `{documentId}`. As a concrete example, the Jentic instance's `page-metadata` collection is included explicitly at `/page-metadatas` and `/page-metadatas/{documentId}`.

Strapi 5 identifies records by a string `documentId` (stable across locales and draft/published versions), not the numeric `id`. Responses use a flattened `data` / `meta` envelope (attributes are no longer nested under `data.attributes` as in v4).

**Draft & Publish caveat:** the `status` query parameter selects draft vs published on reads, but Strapi 5 has no built-in REST route to publish/unpublish, and create/update over REST auto-publishes regardless of a `status=draft` hint (see strapi/strapi#21544, #24547). Verify `publishedAt` on the response rather than trusting the parameter.
